characters.name: David "Dave" Seville
characters.description: David "Dave" Seville is a songwriter, as well as the guardian of the Chipmunks, and the Chipettes as of the second live-action movie. While Dave struggles to remain calm and objective, Alvin often irritates him, causing Dave to yell "Alvin!" to which Alvin responds with "Okay!" Dave plays piano and the guitar. Alternate Catchphrase Inflection: In rare instances where it is not done out of annoyance, Dave's famous "ALVIN!" is delivered worried or desperately, such as when the 'Munks are lost, kidnapped, or to get their attention. Big Ol' Eyebrows: Has very thick eyebrows befitting his strict persona. Butt-Monkey: TheStraight Manto more than six decades of the boys' comedy. Calling Parents by Their Name: Despite considering him their father and taking his last name as their own, the Chipmunks usually call him "Dave" and rarely "dad".

characters.name: Trope as Trio
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job:After receiving their eye colors in the middle of the '80s series — blue for Alvin, blue-grey for Simon, green for Theodore — Alvin's eye color changed to brown for the live action quadrology, while the 2015 relaunch gives him his blue eyes back while Theodore gets the brown eyes. Simon's is the only one whose eye color is kept, albeit now slightly darker blue than Alvin's.Simon's glasses were originally black, but changed to blue to match his shirt and eyes beginning with Season 2 of the 80s show. They reverted back to black for the monster duology and live action movies, but the 2015 CGI series returns them to blue. After receiving their eye colors in the middle of the '80s series — blue for Alvin, blue-grey for Simon, green for Theodore — Alvin's eye color changed to brown for the live action quadrology, while the 2015 relaunch gives him his blue eyes back while Theodore gets the brown eyes. Simon's is the only one whose eye color is kept, albeit now slightly darker blue than Alvin's. Simon's glasses were originally black, but changed to blue to match his shirt and eyes beginning with Season 2 of the 80s show. They reverted back to black for the monster duology and live action movies, but the 2015 CGI series returns them to blue. Adaptation Personality Change: Their personalities were radically altered for the four live action movies given its "real world" aesthetic, such as Simon losing his interest in science and inventions and Theodore is no longer a baker. Only Alvin strays from this, albeit he isn't much of a skater or athlete than he was in the shows. Age Lift: Though their ages are ambiguous, the '80s series and films show them attending elementary school, placing them around 8-12 years old. The live action film quadrology and onward ages them up to perpetual tweens-early teens, as they are shown attending high school with teenagers.

characters.name: Alvin Seville
characters.description: The lead vocalist of the band and main character, Alvin is an impulsive and charmingAttention Whorewho always seems to make up hare-brained schemes to get what his goal is at the time, whether it be trying to help his brothers, keeping Dave from figuring something out, or getting out of a sticky situation. The Ace: Throughout the franchise, Alvin is shown to excel in many areas - he's part of the popular/cool kids, musically gifted (a great vocalist, a good dancer, raps, reeks with charm and stage presence, and plays multiple instruments), athletic (plays basketball, football, soccer, etc.), and has legitskateboardingskills. In short, he's crazy talented. Age Lift: In the '80s series, Alvin was the oldest Chipmunk by five minutes despite his height, but the first live-action film's novelization and the 2015 series onward make him the middle sibling, in fitting with his persona. Agent Mulder: Aliens, monsters, zombies, conspiracies, Alvin believes in everything, and his gullibility is often the source of problems in the family. Anti-Hero: Alvin's flawed, but his heart bears no real evil, and he has set moral guidelines. He nonetheless lacksproperheroic traits that would bring to question a fullThe Herostatus.

characters.name: Simon Seville
characters.description: The tallest, Simon has an IQ north ofAlbert Einstein, possessing a dry sense of humor as well as a keen wit. He takes charge when Alvin goes too far with his hairbrained schemes. Simon loves Alvin, although he secretly worries that they share the same gene pool. Age Lift: He was the middle Chipmunk in the '80s series and filmsdespite his height, but the first live-action film's novelization and the 2015 series and onward make him the oldest, to better align with his mature personality. Agent Scully: He is often very skeptical about Alvin's crazy theories and with good reason. Alliterative Name: The letters of his first and last name both begin with an "S". Beware the Nice Ones: He’s usually kind and patient. However, should anything upset him, he will go off in a fit of rage. A couple of examples are in ''The Squeakquel' where he attacks a couple of bullies for picking on Theodore and even beating up Alvin a couple of times for choosing to impress a group of jocks over being with his brothers.

characters.name: Theodore Seville
characters.description: Not only is he the child of innocence as well as the youngest, but Theodore is shy, loving, sensitive, chubby, gullible, trusting and naïve. In short, he is an easy target for Alvin's manipulations, often holding the swing vote between his two brothers' choices of action. Simon appeals to Theodore's better nature while Alvin goes straight to bribery. All-Loving Hero: Ever since the days ofThe Alvin ShowTheodore's been this, bordering onFriend to All Living Things, and sometimes taking onExtreme Doormattendencies. Says quite a lot about him that when a bully is stealing his food, he makes sure to cater his lunch for the bully's tastes. Anti-Hero:When he becomes a werewolf inMeet the Wolfman, Theodore plays aNominal HeroType . Beware the Nice Ones: The nicest of the brothers, but do not get him angry.ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunksmakes it an occasional point in episodes likeBlabbermouth,Adventures in Babysitting,Talking Teddy's RevengeandWarren Sevillethat, as sweet as he is, Theodore can be shockingly creative in getting back at people who upset him. And inSwitcheroo, he outright beats up a thief who was attempting to kidnap Alvin. Big Beautiful Man: While "beautiful" is not the right word. Theodore is the chubby one of the group, but he's still portrayed as the cute one.

characters.name: Brittany Miller
characters.description: The lead singer and the oldest, Brittany has a pleasing facial and physical appearance, though at times can be vain and self-serving with the extreme desire to have whatever she wants, but is still very caring. Adaptational Nice Guy:In contrast to the 1980s cartoon, the live-action films make her friendlier and more polite, making it easier for others to approach her. She is nicer and has better control over her temper than Alvin does, though she is still more temperamental than most people.In contrast to the 1980s cartoon, the CGI series made her slightly nicer, retaining some "diva" traits, but also making her more hardworking and polite than before. In contrast to the 1980s cartoon, the live-action films make her friendlier and more polite, making it easier for others to approach her. She is nicer and has better control over her temper than Alvin does, though she is still more temperamental than most people. In contrast to the 1980s cartoon, the CGI series made her slightly nicer, retaining some "diva" traits, but also making her more hardworking and polite than before. Attention Whore: Like Alvin, Brittanycravesthe spotlight and gets annoyed if she's not in it.

characters.name: Jeanette Miller
characters.description: Like Simon, Jeanette is themiddle sister despite being the tallestand smartest of the Chipettes. Absent-Minded Professor: Gifted with extraordinary intelligence, she is often so caught up in contemplating the universe that she forgets the simple matters of life, such as not tripping over her own feet. Advertised Extra: Despite being a major character, she gets severely shafted inThe Squeakquel, having around ten lines in the entire film minus the singing. She gets a larger role inChipwrecked, however. All-Loving Hero: She feels sorry for bullies, thinking they must havehorrible home lives. Beautiful All Along: WhenShe Cleans Up Nicely, evenBrittanyis jealous.

characters.name: Eleanor Miller
characters.description: The youngest of her sisters, Eleanor has a lot in common with Theodore in terms of body shape, interests, and color of attire, but she is braver and more athletic. Acrofatic: A gifted athlete and the most athletic out of the six next to Alvin, despite her larger physique. Adaptation Personality Change:In the live-action movies, she has a much softer and childish personality; she acts almost exactly like Theodore and seems extremely naive.The 2015 series made Eleanor more of aDeadpan Snarkerand a horror buff. It also leaned more into her athleticism while downplaying her love of cooking. In the live-action movies, she has a much softer and childish personality; she acts almost exactly like Theodore and seems extremely naive. The 2015 series made Eleanor more of aDeadpan Snarkerand a horror buff. It also leaned more into her athleticism while downplaying her love of cooking.

characters.name: Clyde Crashcup
characters.description: Clyde Crashcup is a scientist, though he’s primarily an inventor rather than a researcher, whose experiments invariably fail. He typically would invent something by taking a pencil out of his lab coat's pocket and drawing a picture in midair of his conception; the picture would then become the actual object. Alliterative Name:ClydeCrashcup. Art Initiates Life: Clyde's method of "invented" is by drawing what he wants in the pencil with a pencil. He's createdpeopleon at least two occasions using this method. Bungling Inventor. Especially given that he is always Reinventing The Wheel (no, the trope is something else)... The Cameo: Appears in Alvin’s dream duringA Chipmunk Christmasas well as in an episode of the 80s/90s show.

characters.name: Leonardo
characters.description: Clyde Crashcup’s short assistant, Leonardo doesn’t speak, only whispering into Clyde’s ear, informing him of his ideas. Leonardo frequently invents or perfects an invention whereas Clyde takes the credit from him, not to mention he’s usually emotionally displeased when Clyde insults his intelligence. Beware the Quiet Ones: When Clyde took an awful beating from a bully in a boxing match, Leonardo stepped into the fight and, after distracting the mannotewhispering to him and pointing at his foot, implying that Leonardo said the guy's shoe was untied, punched him out with an uppercut. Ditzy Genius: While very smart in general, he does have his moments of naiveté and cluelessness sometimes, such as when he opened a glass windowpane to see the rain outside, and Clyde had to tell him that wasn't necessary. Eye Glasses: Like Simon, his glasses are thick and cover his entire eyes. Hidden Depths: Can play the harp and cello.

characters.name: Stanley the Eagle
characters.description: As his name may suggest, Stanley’s an eagle who befriends the Chipmunks. Acrophobic Bird: Before the boys taught him, Stanley was initially too scared to fly. Nice Guy: Doesn’t mean any harm to anyone. No Social Skills: Tries singing with other birds in his last appearance (“Eagle Music”) but becomes an outcast. Only Known by Their Nickname: Or at least by the name given by the Chipmunks.

characters.name: Daisy Bell(e)
characters.description: Daisy Bell(e) is a girl who pesters the Chipmunks at times or tries to be friends with them. Appears in “Three Blind Mice,” “Sir Alvin” and “Bicycle Built for Two.” Disappeared Dad: Her mother’s seen onscreen toward the end of “Three Blind Mice” and is heard off screen in “Sir Alvin” but her father is never mentioned. Not Good with Rejection: Rides away upset from Theodore when she tries flirting with him, but the green-clad Chipmunk only notices her new bike. Upon receiving the same response with Simon, Daisy promptly destroys his erector set he was finishing up with her bike. Daisy then gets into an argument with Alvin when he comments on her bike instead of her.

characters.name: Sam Valiant
characters.description: A fast talking short man in a tan trench coat, with only his nose visible in which he relies his decisions on by what smells and, combined with his carelessness, causes destruction. Sam Valiant’s quick to place blame on or con the person closest to them. Appears in “Sam Valiant, Private Nose,” “Sam Valiant: Real Estate” and “Dude Ranch.” Determinator: Tries to have Dave use one of the songs he’s written when overhearing Dave’s attempting to create a western song while the latter and the Chipmunks are on vacation. Dreadful Musician: In "Dude Ranch", he tries to audition for Dave and the Chipmunks, singing for them whenever he sees them. The only one who seems to appreciate it is a howling coyote at the end of the cartoon. Motor Mouth: Whenever he's on screen, he almost never shuts up. New Job as the Plot Demands: Was a shady private investigator in his first appearance, a real estate agent in his next and hotel room clerk in his last appearance.

characters.name: Mrs. Frumpington
characters.description: A very annoying neighbor woman who’s the head of a group called ‘The Ladies of the Square’, who detests the Chipmunks’ music. Mrs. Frumpington can be seen as representing the ‘proper’ ladies and acceptable societal behavior. Appears in “Squares” and “Good Manners.” Accidental Misnaming: She never can get Dave or Alvin's name right, referring to them as "Mr. Savoy" and "Calvin" respectively. She also calls Theodore "Theophilus" the first time she meets the Chipmunks. Large Ham: ESPECIALLY during her big number at the end of "Sqaures". Pretty in Mink: Wears a fur shawl when she first appears. Proper Lady: When Dave once complained to her about the boys' complete lack of manners, she volunteers to teach them suggesting that maybe they just need a woman's touch.It works a little too well.

characters.name: JPLester
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: Though not intentionally considering Dave and the Chipmunks don’t notice himuntil the very end. A Day in the Limelight: His onetime episode appearance focuses a little more on his exploits of trying to scare Dave and the Chipmunks from Chesley Estate. Evil Laugh: Does thisbefore failing to scare Alvin. The Noseless: Well, heisa literal bed sheet ghost. Our Ghosts Are Different: Being an actualbedsheet ghostnot only qualifies but he's solid enough that Dave's able to pick him up and hold him, not to mention being able to fit into tight places like in a can.

characters.name: Chuck Wagon
characters.description: A southern boy with a distinct southern accent, Chuck Wagon is Dave’s second cousin, twice removed on his father's side. Lacking self-confidence because everybody tells him he’s not good at anything, Chuck comes for a visit in hopes to find something he is good at and the Chipmunks help him. Appears in “Hillbilly Son.” Apologizes a Lot: Each time he fails a task given by the Chipmunks,even when he thinks his signing (which heisgood at but can’t see it) is obtrusive. Book Dumb: Took aVERYlong time just to read from a basic readers book that’s basically abrand xversion ofDick and Jane. Clothing Damage: Though at the hem of his shirt and pants. Desperately Looking for a Purpose in Life: Tries to find something he is good at butfails to see he can sing country tunes to which he considers nothing special.

characters.name: Miss Beatrice Miller
characters.description: Apron Matron: Because of her age, she has difficulty transitioning into a mother figure for the girls as she initially treats them as babies. Though she at first believes she isn't the best person to take care of The Chipettes, she grows to love and appreciate their company. The Cameo/The Faceless: Is only heard screaming “DAAAAAVVVVIIIIIID!!!” on the phone inMeet the Wolfmanbecause Alvin scared the Chipettes to death and they ran all the way to their house in panic. Cloudcuckoolander: Sometimes has strong traces of this, especially inA Chipmunk Adventure. In the episode "Goin’ Down to Dixie" not only she forget the girls on the sidewalk to drive to the airport, but she also forgot to buy tickets. Though this trait considerably toned down in later seasons as she becomes established as the parental figure for the Chipettes. Demoted to Extra: She appears in only a handful of episodes inALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks(because the Chipettes live in their home on the tree next to Dave's house). Drives Like Crazy: Miss Miller is shown to be dangerous in a car and the boys are usually terrified by her driving. She is seen in multiple episodes speeding, swerving across the road, and hitting objects such as fire hydrants and light poles. Her flying isn't much better.

characters.name: Vinny
characters.description: A kind, good natured anthropomorphic chipmunk, Vinny is Alvin, Simon and Theodore’s biological motherwho left her babies with Dave Seville because he was nice to the forest animals, because she realized that her boys wouldn't survive the journey if she brought them with her when all the animals in the forest were forced to abandon their homes due to a horrible winter storm. When spring came, Vinny finally returned to get them but she saw how happy they were with Dave, and thought they would be better off with him.Appears in “A Chipmunk Reunion” and “Vinny’s Visit.” Daddy Had a Good Reason for Abandoning You:As single mother, she reveals to her sonsnotewhere she was named for the first time, and given a specific look outside the aforementioned hood that she worethat she left them on Dave's doorstep because she genuinely couldn't support all four of them in a particularly snowy and cold winter. At one point, she did try to get them but after seeing how happy they were with Dave, she decides to leave them to their "new life". Fish Out of Water: When she comes to visit the boys in the city where to brought her animal friends with her, much to Dave's chagrin, and causes trouble in the process like buying a lot of stuff. Granola Girl: A mild example. In the Hood:In her first appearance (when she first leaves her boys on Dave's doorstep in the flashback), she wears a hood which hides her face and doesn't speak.

characters.name: Grandma & Grandpa Seville
characters.description: In their first two appearances, they were farmers living in fictional South Spoon Ranch. Though in their last, they lived just a couple blocks from Dave’s school whereas Grandpa Seville is an accountant and Grandma Seville is possibly a typical housewife. The Cameo: Both appear in “Merry Christmas, Mr. Carrol.” Cloudcuckoolander: In their first appearances. Hey, You!: They are even referred to as ‘grandpa’ and ‘grandma’ byeach other! Nice Guy/Nice GirlOr at least subverted for Grandpa Seville in his last appearance.

characters.name: "Uncle" Harry
characters.description: Harry’s a charlatan anthropomorphic scruffy chipmunk who claims to be the Chipmunks’ long lost uncle in hopes to pay off a debt by convincing the boys to work with him to raise moneyso that they can visit their mother. Overall, Harry uses similar schemes throughout the series to try and get the Chipmunks (as well as Chipettes) to work for him so he can steal their earnings but always seems to backfire. Appears in “Uncle Harry,” “Lights, Camera, Alvin,” “Santa Harry” and “A Little Worm in the Big Apple.” The Antagonist: The main one for the Chipmunks during the early series. Can't Get Away with Nuthin': Is doomed to fail in his schemes when he crosses the Chipmunks,although he successfully scammed the Chipettes . . . but that doesn’t meanthe Chipmunks aren’t gonna do anything about it. Con Man: In every episode with him, he uses schemes to try and get The Chipmunks and The Chipettes to work for him so that he can steal their earnings; however, he never succeeds in actually stealing from either group in any of these episodes. Evil Uncle: Subverted. He initially just claim to be the Chipmunks’ long lost uncle, but is a lie for his scheme. Howewer, he is called always "Uncle" Harry despite no parental link.

characters.name: Marsha
characters.description: Marsha was a young woman who Dave felt he had a strong connection with while dating her. She is also a single mother of three boys named Maxwell, Chucky and Eddy. Appears in “Dave’s Getting Married.” The Ace: Solves the Chipmunks’ problems quite easily, (Alvin hitting the bulls-eye with his baseball, Simon with some mathematical if not scientific equation and Theodore with cooking), which gains the Chipmunks liking her. Birds of a Feather: Feels a strong connection with Dave but the only thing holding them back is their boys constant bickering against each other. Ink-Suit Actor:Marsha◊was based offJanice Karman◊. The Ghost: She’s mentioned in “Grounded Chipmunk” but not seen.

characters.name: Maxwell, Chucky & Eddy
characters.description: Big Eater: Eddy, possibly more so than Theodore. Blonde, Brunette, Redhead:Blonde = MaxwellBrunette = EddyRedhead = Chucky Captain Ersatz/Expies: Basically human versions of Simon (Maxwell), Alvin (Chucky) and Theodore (Eddy). Disappeared Dad: Their father’s not mentioned or is even hinted if he’s dead or divorced. Fat Bastard: Eddy’s a kid variant.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.description: Clothing Damage: At least while at the orphanage. Even her toes were peeping out of her right shoe! Cool Big Sis: For the Chipettes. No Name Given:Her adopted parents. Only One Name: Subverted. She mentions getting her bracelet from her (birth) mother, so we assume she has onebut we also don’t learn her new last name when she’s adopted. Parental Substitute: To the baby Chipettes.

characters.name: Miss Grudge
characters.description: A very unpleasant woman who runs the “Miss Grudge’s Orphanage” in Australia where Olivia and the Chipettes lived, Miss Grudge sought a way to make money by forcing kids to sing for her.When she finds out the Chipettes can not only talk but sing as well, Miss Grudge promptly kidnaps and locks them away in hopes to use their singing for her own needs. Fortunately, they escaped.Appears in “The Chipette Story.” Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Displays a pleasant personain front of the couple who adopts Olivia and when the girl can’t find the Chipettes, she told her they ran away. Dreadful Musician: She wonders why her singing Orphans Group’s singing are off...

characters.name: Eva
characters.description: Eva’s a selfish, young girl who lived in the same orphanage as Olivia and knows the infant Chipettes can sing and threatens to tell Grudge. Appears in “The Chipette Story.” Blackmail: Threatens to tell Miss Grudge about the Chipettes’ signing ability unless Olivia gives the bracelet given by her mother to Eva.Until the Chipettes decided to steal it back, alerting Grudge to the commotion Eva and the Chipettes caused leads the woman to learn about the Chipettes. Miss Grudge wouldn’t have learned they could talk ifBrittanyhadn’t opened her mouth, thus leading to Eva revealing the fact they can sing.

characters.name: Uncle “Adventure” Willy
characters.description: Despite his elderly appearance, Uncle Willy, nicknamed “Uncle Adventure,” is a strong and active man who’s determined to not let anyone tell him how young he can act as a result of his age. One of the Kids: Despite his age, plays with the Chipmunks.

characters.name: Miss Smith
characters.description: Apathetic Teacher: Miss Smith is an unpleasant person most of the time and Alvin doesn't help. She is sometimes annoyed so badly she allows Alvin to leave detention early, just so she doesn't have to listen to him anymore. Dean Bitterman: She has little to no tolerance for Alvin's shenanigans. Expy: She seems really similar to the principal in the episode "The Brunch Club" fromthe 80s series. Stern Teacher: Eventually turns into this asCharacterization Marches On. While she remains cynical and rough as in the earlier seasons, as time goes on she becomes more prone to peppering her cynicism with genuine desire to see her students - even Alvin - do well - and she can generally be counted on to go out of her way to be in the kids' corner even in their personal lives if they need her to be.

characters.name: Derek Smalls
characters.description: The Bully: Derek is initially portrayed as the school bully, often to the entire Chipmunk trio. Demoted to Extra: His role as such decreases in latter episodes. Even Bullies Have Standards: He hates Bocarter like the rest of his classmates. Freudian Excuse: In Save The Dance it is revealed that his father hits him, and is quite verbally abrasive. The seemingly abusive nature of his family could be why Derek bullies at school. Those Two Guys: He is seen hanging around with two other boys in some episodes.

characters.name: Bocarter Humphrey
characters.description: 0% Approval Rating: Bocarter tends to be hated by everyone in school. He is the one person that Theodore and Jeanette truly hate, and even the bully Derek can't stand him. This is mostly because of Bocarter being extremely cruel and greedy and narcissistic and downright rotten and spoiled, which disgusts everyone greatly. Not even a single kid or student in the neighbourhood would invite Bocarter to their parties because of his rotten behaviour and for being a greedy narcissist who often breaks the law and endangers animals. Arch-Enemy: To the Chipmunks (especially Alvin) and Chipettes as a whole. Big Bad: Becomes this as the CGI series goes on. Cruella to Animals: He tends to lock up animals (especially monkeys) in cages to make them do what he wants and never gives them any freedom and treats them more like slaves than pets. Evil Brit: Bocarter comes across as this, with his posh British accent, and often challenging the Chipmunks in some way to show them up (and will even do what he has to to sabotage them in the process).

characters.name: Cheesy
characters.description: The Ditz: Cheesy is not especially bright, and has a lot of strange habits. Simple-Minded Wisdom: Cheesy is considered a loser, but he's also one of the only students who doesn't particularly care about popularity and is fine with who he is.

characters.name: Kevin Hanson
characters.description: The Apprentice: He turns out to be fairly gifted musically, and spends some time as Dave's student (after Alvin conned him into being a student) before Dave directs him to an internship. Cannot Spit It Out: In "Secret Admirer", to a girl the kids initially believe is one of the Chipettes before it turns out to be someone else. Depending on the Writer: Kevin is either a pretty good friend to everyone, or can be kind of a jerk sometimes. Stereotypical Nerd: A classic example. Nonathletic body, above-average intellect and interested in mathematics and video games. With Friends Like These...: Particularly in the earlier seasons. Kevin seems to be the biggest example of this, as it's not uncommon for him to tease any of his friends, such as when Cheesy believes he's got an online girlfriend, or even get them into some kind of trouble, like when he and Cheesy begin prank-calling people in the neighborhood and it comes back to bite them in the butt.

characters.name: Officer Dangus
characters.description: Can't Get Away with Nuthin': Just about the only time heisn'tin over his head is when the Chipmunks do something illegal, at which point he usually shows up to complicate things. Cloudcuckoolander: He's not always that bright considering his advice for kids to take whatever dangerous risks necessary to be a hero. Cool Shades: Has large large sunglasses. Embarrassing First Name: It's revealed in "Double Dangus" that his first name isDoris. Expy: He seems an awful lot like a modern dayBarney Fife.

characters.name: Principal Meadows
characters.description: Precocious Crush: In "Principal Interest", Alvin develops a crush for her. Reasonable Authority Figure: In stark contrast to Miss Smith, Principal Meadows is quite a generous and easygoing person by comparison, giving the children a fair bit of leeway before administering punishment.

characters.name: Julie
characters.description: Platonic Life-Partners: She and Dave are very close, and they've even gone on a couple of apparent dates, but each time its made very clear that they're just friends and mostly just swap parenting tips. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: She was a fairly recurring character in the first couple of seasons, but eventually faded away as Miss Miller began to show up as the family's friend in the neighborhood more often.

characters.name: Ms. Croner
characters.description: Crazy Cat Lady: She has several cats, whom she is all-too happy to force people to help take care of them. They are just as mean as she is, and particularly enjoy chasing chimpunks - especially Theodore. Heroic Comedic Sociopath: Ms. Croner ishilariouslyamoral, and sees no issue with taking advantage of people or outright committing crimes for a laugh or to make a point. Despite this, she seems to genuinely like the Sevilles deep down and several of her antics have been for what she believes is their own good. More than once the cast has teamed up with her to do something nasty for a good cause. I Have Brothers: Alvin at one point tries to get into a prank war with her. She then reveals that she grew up with seven brothers and effortlessly turns all of his pranks back against him. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: As noted, she's been known to do good things for the Sevilles and Miss Miller out of the goodness of her heart, even if her methods are typically as abrasive as she is. Scatterbrained Senior: She routinelyforgets the characters' names, though shemightbe faking it or simply not care to ever learn theirs.

characters.name: The Furschtein Siblings
characters.description: A pair of Europeans running an international diamond smuggling ring, running out of ways of delivering $5 million of diamonds to customers without government interference. Both find an opportunity when they overhear Alvin and Brittany arguing over who would win an actual race around the world, to which the Furschtein have the Chipmunks and Chipettes travel in different directions around the world in hot air balloons, stopping at twelve different locations, where they would deliver a doll of themselvesfull of diamondsand receive a doll of the other teamfull of money. This is in hopes that[Inspector] Jamalwon't expect them. Big Bad Duumvirate: The main antagonists ofThe Chipmunk Adventure. Big Fancy House: Their estate is absolutelysprawlingwith an enormous mansion, pool, and garden with a huge fountain. Brother–Sister Team: A villainous version alongside Klaus. Cool Car: Their Rolls-Royce Silver Cloud I

characters.name: Jamal
characters.description: A shady-looking character who has two men named Cisvan and Cuomo working for him, Jamal seems to know Claudia and Klaus Furschtein.It's revealed he's an inspector working forINTERPOLand been working to bust the illegal international diamond smuggling ring run by Claudia and Klaus and been trying to put them into custody for years. Chair Reveal: How he's introduced. The Determinator:Been going after the siblings for years. Good All Along:He is a inspector, part ofINTERPOLLos Angeles Division. Obviously Evil: Subverted. Sends his two goons after the Chipmunks and Chipettes when he's first introducedbut it's revealed he's on their side and only wants them safely returned home.

characters.name: Cisvan and Cuomo
characters.description: Bumbling Henchmen Duo: Jamal's incompetent minions who are seldom apart. Butt Monkeys: Had a very hard time trying to capture both Chipmunks and Chipettes. Good All Along: While the two of them look like thugs,it turns out they’re reallyINTERPOLagents trying to put a stop to the diamond smuggling operation. You Have Failed MeJamal:You imbeciles, I ask you to take candy from a baby and you fail me miserably!

characters.name: The Sheikh
characters.description: Averyyoung prince who has the Chipettes kidnapped byInspector Jamal's request and tries to make Brittany one of his wives. A Child Shall Lead Them: He is very young but appears to have authority. Interspecies Romance: He decides to keep Brittany in his palace and marry her when they come of age in a decade or so. Royal Brat: Very spoiled and demanding to his advisors. Vague Age: He is a child but it's never stated how old he is.

characters.name: The Natives
characters.description: A group of Natives who kidnapped Theodore when he and his brothers decided to camp in a jungle on Howland Island while taking a shortcut, crowning him "Prince of Plenty" and forcing Alvin and Simon to serve him. Appease the Volcano God:What they planned to do to Theodore (along with Alvin and Simon) during the full moon by feeding them to a pit of crocodiles as Simon and Alvin find out by reading a series of ideograms on the walls of a cave. God Guise: Mistake Theodore for their 'Prince of Plenty.' Hollywood Natives: An African tribe whose members wearloin cloths, donTribal Face Paint, and haveSavage Piercings. One-Gender Race: No women are seen...

characters.name: Doktor Frankenstein
characters.description: As his last name may hint, Frankenstein is a mad scientist who inhabits the new attraction "Frankenstein's Castle" at the Majestic Movie Studios where he makes another monster. When he spots the Chipmunks (who, not only missed their own show, but are locked inside the theme park) spying on him, Frankenstein sends his creation after them, though when later tracking the creature, Frankensteinspots him at the Sevilles' home, and, angered at the monster's benevolence kidnaps Alvin to make the red-clad Chipmunk into his new monster. Adaptational Villainy/Card-Carrying Villain: Portrayed as suchwho abducts Alvin to change him into a monster when he is upset by the original monster'sGentle Giantnature. Irony:Really hates the theme park Sammy Squirrel mascot, but is forced to sneak inside the premiere dressed as Sammy Squirrel in hopes to change Alvin back into a monster but unfortunately is electrocuted and is stuck in the Sammy Squirrel costume. Mad Scientist: Much more so than Crashcup.

characters.name: "Frankie" the Frankenstein Monster
characters.description: A monster created by Doktor Frankenstein, who eventually befriends the Chipmunks. Big Damn Heroes:Along with Theodore and Simon, little late to save Alvin from the potion forcibly given to him by Doktor Frankenstein that'll make him into a zany cartoonish monster but does rescue him before the process could be completed.Toward the end of the film, a disguised Frankenstein sees Alvin (who was transformed into a zany cartoon monster by the mad doctor but couldn't finish the process) back to normal but realizes if he shocks Alvin he will cause the Chipmunk to change back, so the doctor turns Alvin's microphone to a high revere. Cue Frankie showing up and grabbing the doctor. As the Frankenstein Monster carries his creator, Frankie slips and Dr. Frankenstein grabs the microphone to steady himself, only to be shocked. This also exposes himself to the public, but the Chipmunks (mainly Theodore) come to his rescue. Toward the end of the film, a disguised Frankenstein sees Alvin (who was transformed into a zany cartoon monster by the mad doctor but couldn't finish the process) back to normal but realizes if he shocks Alvin he will cause the Chipmunk to change back, so the doctor turns Alvin's microphone to a high revere. Cue Frankie showing up and grabbing the doctor. As the Frankenstein Monster carries his creator, Frankie slips and Dr. Frankenstein grabs the microphone to steady himself, only to be shocked. This also exposes himself to the public, but the Chipmunks (mainly Theodore) come to his rescue. Captain Ersatz: Basically the animated version ofUniversal'sFrankenstein Monsterplayed byBoris Karloff. Drives Like Crazy:As a result of Alvin teaching him how, he drives tourists around the sets in a bus rather recklessly.

characters.name: Ted Yesman
characters.description: The neurotic, overworked overseer of the Majestic Movie Studios theme park (a parody ofUniversal Studios Hollywood). Nervous Wreck: He's so in fear of losing his job that he often unloads his problems on Dave. Unwitting Instigator of Doom: In a desperate attempt to make the Frankenstein's Castle attraction scarier, he hires therealDr. Frankenstein.

characters.name: Phil the Tour Guide
characters.description: An aspiring actor who serves as the tour guide/bus driver at Majestic Movie Studios.

characters.name: Lawrence Talbot
characters.description: The Seville's next door neighbor, Lawrence Talbot,as his name may suggestis also a werewolfwho bites Theodore, turning him into a werewolf as well. Though after both are cured of their lycanthropy, Talbot becomes the new principal of Clyde C. Crashcup Elementary School. Being Evil Sucks:He hated being under the curse of the werewolf, as evidenced by him thanking Theodore for curing him. Credits Gag: Listed in the credits as "Mr. Talbot, the Wolfman". Expy: Of Lon Chaney, Jr.'sLarry Talbotcharacter. Involuntary Shapeshifter: During the night of the full moon, which happens at the same night of the Chipmunks' and Chipettes' school play.

characters.name: Mr. Rochelle
characters.description: The very flamboyant and overly melodramatic drama director at Clyde C. Crashcup Elementary School, Mr. Rochelle is a member of the Elementary School Theatrical Directors' Bowling League. Flamboyant Gay: Bursts into hysterical tears when told Alvin couldn't be Mr. Hyde.

characters.name: Principal Milliken
characters.description: The principal of Clyde C. Crashcup Elementary Schooluntil she goes into early retirement as principal and takes a job "driving trucks full of nitroglycerin across rickety bridges in South America". Younger Than They Look: The stress of dealing with Alvin for so long has done this to her.Dave:You don't look a day over fifty.Milliken:I'm thirty-one!

characters.name: Nathan
characters.description: A bully who looks like he had been held back a year or two, Nathan takes pleasure in tormenting Theodore, though he does suffer retaliation from Alvin. The Bully: For Theodore. Establishing Character Moment: The first time we see Nathan, he's threatening Theodore with physical harm for doing his job as sound effects person for the play. Heel–Face Turn: He stops harassing Theodore after Theodore shows compassion following Nathan attempting to humiliate him. Laser-Guided Karma: Bullying Theodore will more often than not result in Alvin standing up for him, usually with a prank.

characters.name: Madame Raya
characters.description: Madam Raya is the host of a television monster movie special first seen in an ad for her book,The Monster Book of Monster Facts.Alvin and Simon seek her out at the TV station to ask for help with changing Theodore back from a werechipmunk. The Cameo: Seen at the end of the movie dancing withLawrence Talbotat the wrap party for the school play. Expy: Likely one toElvira, Mistress of the Dark. Our Lawyers Advised This Trope: In promoting her book, "you must be eighteen to call, but don't worry, we don't ask."

characters.name: Lalu
characters.description: A friend of Dave’s who agreed to watch over the six toddler Chipmunks and Chipettes on short notice while he’s away, Lalu lives in a cottage along with P.C. and Gilda. Friend to All Children: Tells Dave she loves having them over and plays along with their games. Nice Girl: Keeps her cool when she finds Gilda has wrapped almost everything with caution tape or even when Theodore accidentally floods the bathroom floor when he clogged the toilet.

characters.name: Gilda
characters.description: Child Hater: Has caution tape wrapped all over the furniture, stating that children have no regards for property and having six children under one roof is a recipe for disaster. Hates Being Touched: Despite saying so, Brittany still hugs her anyways. The Fashionista: Says to have a flare for fashion when she decides to help The Chipmunks, Brittany and Jeanette with the costumes while Lalu’s attending Eleanor.

characters.name: P.C.
characters.description: The other resident living with Lalu, P.C. is a tropical frog. Massive Numbered Siblings:Considering female amphibians lay about around 200 to 20000 eggs, P.C. isn’t really consistent.P.C.Like my mom always says, ‘nothing warms up a home like children’s laughter. She should know, she had twelve thousand of us babies on the same day!Gilda:Twelve thousand! Oh, P.C., last time it was twelve hundred!P.C.:Well, I know there’s a twelve in there. Overly Long Tongue: Well, heisa frog . . . Only Known by Their Nickname: ‘P.C.’ stands for Prince Charming. Prince Charming: States to be one kiss away to be one, though the topic is never brought up again.

characters.name: Sam and Lou
characters.description: A fat, short talking gopher, Lou does the most of going into a character’s mind. Big Ol' Unibrow: Hard to see, but in different lighting they’re a shade darker. Butt-Monkey: Suffers the most from going into a character’s thoughts. Fat and Skinny: Fat to Sam’s skinny Eyes Always Shut: Either this or the creators forgot to put them on the puppet.

characters.name: Lalu’s Toilet
characters.description: As the name may suggest, Lalu’s toilet is somehow brought to life after Theodore accidentally fills it with random objects, thus flooding it and Lalu cleans up the mess. Suddenly Voiced: Shewasjust a normal toilet a moment ago.

characters.name: Ian Hawke
characters.description: The founderand formerchairman ofJETTRecords, Ian Hawke attended college with his ex-roommate Dave and Claire Wilson. When Dave first entered the headquarters, Ian wanted to be his boss since he was no longer Dave's college roommate; instead, he became his "best friend." Actor Allusion: Him wearing a pelican suit inChipwreckedsounds like he's channeling his innerMaster Crane(even though they're different types of birds).Coincidentally,Kung Fu Panda 2was released in the same year as whenChipwreckedcame out. Coincidentally,Kung Fu Panda 2was released in the same year as whenChipwreckedcame out. Bald of Evil: He starts as this initially, getting better later on. Big Bad: Serves as the primary antagonist of the first two films.

characters.name: Claire Wilson
characters.description: Dave’s off-and-on girlfriend who lives across the street from him, Claire has recently enjoyed her success in photography for magazines and shown to have broken up with Dave (who’s still in love with Claire and is constantly trying to rekindle their relationship) due to his inability to take their relationship seriously. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Doesn’t appear or even gets a mention in any future films in the series, and byRoad Chip, Dave gets a completely new love interest. It's All About Me: She spends a lot of her time in the first film trying to get Dave to pay attention to her, or trying to relate a situation back to her relationship with him, even when it's totally irrelevant. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: She spends the entirety of the first filmtrying to get Dave to focus on her without caring for his circumstances, yet does aid him in stopping Ian from sending the titular Alvin and co. on their tour for his greedy ends. Love Interest: For Dave.

characters.name: Tobin "Toby" Seville
characters.description: Dave’s immature, lazy cousin who loves to play video games, Toby is a slacker who becomes the Chipmunks’ guardian after heaccidentally sends his grandmother to the hospital. It’s also revealed he knows Julie and still has a crush on her since high school. Basement Dweller: He refuses to seek employment, does nothing but play video games, eat and sleep all day and expects his Aunt Jackie (and probably his parents off-screen) to keep supporting him. Big Good: Literally. He's the primary human ally for the Chipmunks in the second film. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Despite being the human protagonist in place of Dave in the second film, he only appears in that installment, and is never mentioned or brought up in any follow-ups. Everyone Has Standards: He's aLazy Bum, but even he won't let the Chipmunks skip school when they're supposed to go.

characters.name: Dr. Rubin
characters.description: West Eastman High School’s principal, Dr. Rubin happens to be an ecstatic Chipmunks fan who persuades them to perform in a music competition to save the school’s music department. I'm Your Biggest Fan: She even shows a tattoo of the Chipmunks on her bicep that she got at their concert in Denver on her birthday. Reasonable Authority Figure: Played with. After hearing the Chipettes sing, Rubin is pressured into allowing a sing-off between the Chipettes and Chipmunks when Ian calls her out for being biased in favor of the Chipmunks and not allowing a democratic vote from the student body.

characters.name: Julie Ortega
characters.description: The teacher of the Chipmunks at West Eastman High School, Julie Ortega was the crush of Toby Seville during high school and it’s implied she may have a crush on him as well. Everyone Went to School Together: Toby and Julie went to West Eastman. Huge Guy, Tiny Girl/One Head Shorter: Is 5'4¼" to Toby’s 6'3¼" Love Interest: For Toby.

characters.name: Ryan Edwards
characters.description: The school jock bully who picks on the Chipmunks, Ryan Edwards is the quarterback on the football team and he becomes jealous when the Chipmunks steal the attention from the girls. Crazy Jealous Guy: Gets pissed when the Chipmunks get all the attention from the girls. Laser-Guided Karma:In the end credits, Ryan and his jocks get their well-deserved punishment for their mistreatment of the Chipmunks by having to scrape chewed gum off the bottom of the bleachers. Manipulative Bastard: When he is surprised by Alvin's skill and talented save in dodgeball at the end of gym class, he befriends the chipmunk and persuades him to join the school's football team.

characters.name: Xander
characters.description: Another jock who plays football. Laser-Guided Karma:In the end credits, Xander and his jocks get their well-deserved punishment for their mistreatment of the Chipmunks by having to scrape chewed gum off the bottom of the bleachers.

characters.name: Becca Kingston
characters.description: Class Princess: She and her crew are very friendly to the chipmunks.

characters.name: Jeremy Smith
characters.description: Laser-Guided Karma:In the end credits, Jeremy and his jocks get their well-deserved punishment for their mistreatment of the Chipmunks by having to scrape chewed gum off the bottom of the bleachers.

characters.name: Aunt “Popcorn” Jackie Seville
characters.description: Dave’s (possible) paternal aunt as well as Toby’s grandmother, Jackie was originally supposed to watch the Chipmunks while Dave was at the hospital, that is until Toby accidentally knocks Jackie's wheelchair down some stairs while getting the boys' luggage, and an airport luggage trolley crashes into her thus making Jackie incapacitated. Expy: Many people who watched the movie initially thought she was supposed to be Ms Miller, the caretaker for the Chipettes from the cartoon. Parental Substitute: Was the original one for Dave. We Hardly Knew Ye: Really, get less than five minutes of screen time. It's also likely she died off-screen in the hospital she was taken to since she never came back.

characters.name: Digger
characters.description: Apparently the Chipmunks’ cousin, Digger makes an appearance during the climatic chase. Deus ex Machina:Pops out of a manhole that forces Ian’s limo off the street, crashing into a light pole while chasing down Alvin and the Chipettes on the toy motorbike. Mascot: For Fox'sNASCARcoverage, for those who don’t know. One-Way Visor: True to how he appears from Fox's NASCAR telecasts. Remember the New Guy?: Both Alvin and Digger seem to know one another.

characters.name: Simone
characters.description: Simone is Simon’s alter-ego, who came to be when Simon is bitten by a spider carrying a neuro-toxin. As a result, he undergoes a polar opposite personality change and it removes Simon's fear of inhibition. Being more adventurous and reckless as well as eager to take more risks despite the consequences and dangers, Simone is a more confident version of Simon, more open about his relationship with Jeanette. The ‘Simone’ persona then disappears when he is hit on the head by a golf ball Zoe threw at him, rendering him unconscious and waking up as Simon again. Blessed with Suck: This alter-ego is really both a blessing and a curse. On one hand, we finally get to see his alter-ego (in Simon's body) overcome Simon's earlier insecurities such as showing his love for Jeanette and in a way, being morewell roundedand street smart by adventurously exploring the island and seeing that there's more to life than just nerdy book-smart. On the other hand, he's amnesiac and doesveryrisky things. Easy Amnesia: This persona is the result of a poisonous spider bite that makes Simon forget who he is. Expy: He seems to be the French Chipmunk version of Spanish Buzz fromToy Story 3. Both are more confident in expressing their feelings for Jeanette and Jessie respectively, and both are alter egos that speak a Romantic Language (with Simone speaking French and Spanish Buzz speaking...well, Spanish.).Ironically, Simone is actually Spanish in the European French Dub. Ironically, Simone is actually Spanish in the European French Dub.

characters.name: Airport Marshall James Suggs
characters.description: Arch-Enemy: Serves as the primary antagonist and arch-nemesis to the Chipmunks in The Road Chip, despising them intensely. Amusing Injuries: His pursuit is a chain of slapstick humiliations — bar fights, sign collisions, unwanted tattoos, and more. Asshole Victim: You won’t feel sorry for any injuries or humiliations he suffers during the movie because he is so unpleasant. Ax-Crazy: Takes his job as an air marshall and officer extremely seriously and holds a powerful grudge against the Chipmunks fortheir music being the theme song of his heartbreak (his girlfriend dumped him while it was playing) and eventually reveals plans to have them stuffed as a gift for his ex so she'll take him backand even channelsThe Shiningwith "here's Suggsy!" Badass Boast: "Nobody runs on Agent James Suggs!" and "HERE'S SUGGSY!"

characters.name: Samantha
characters.description: Anger Born of Worry: She goes off on her son and the Chipmunks when she and Dave discover their sons left home. Beware the Nice Ones: She's a very sweet woman overall, but when she gets angry, her son and the Chipmunks are all terrified. Hospital Hottie: She's a very attractive heart surgeon. That Came Out Wrong: When Dave reveals to the Chipmunks that the engagement ring wasn't his, Samantha becomes relieved that he isn't proposing to her, which confuses Dave until Samantha explains that she actually wants them to take their relationship slowly. The Not-Love Interest: Between the engagement ring, Dave choosing her to be the one to invite to Miami after having apparently known and having talked about her for months, and Dave even stating that she’s going to become “.- big part of [his] life”, it’s clear that the movie does all it can to point to Dave intending to propose to Samantha. It isn’t till the third act that Dave finally reveals that the ring he had was actually one he was carrying for a friend, which relieves Samantha as she wanted to take her relationship with Dave slow.

characters.name: Miles
characters.description: Disappeared Dad: His father left him when he was five. Freudian Excuse: His dad left him which is why he behaves badly. Jerkass: His initial mean behavior to the Chipmunks is completely unprovoked. The Chipmunks are afraid that Miles will be a cruel stepbrother if Dave married Samantha. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: He initially bullies the Chipmunks, but during their trip to Miami, he bonds with them and actually becomes sad when they celebrate having ruined Dave's supposed proposal to his mother. Love at First Sight: The instant Ashley Grey shows up at the recording studio, Miles is so awestruck at seeing her that he accidentally spills his soda on Theodore.

characters.name: Ashley Grey
characters.description: Ship Tease: With Miles, as she is seen asking him to come to a future party in LA.
